entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Westerly winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 70 to 100 mm of rain, mainly east of Whakatane, possibly more in localised downpours. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h, but possible 25 to 40 mm/hr in downpours. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Watch upgraded to an Orange Warning and Gisborne/Tairawhiti north of Ruatoria added to this Warning. Note, the Watch for western Bay of Plenty has been also added to this warning.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers turning to snow Sunday afternoon about the summit and may lower to 800 metres in the evening. Expect 3 to 6 cm about the summit with lesser amounts to 800 metres. Note, this warning may be extended into Monday evening.
